job_spec.name: hbm_smh_tcc-6f7adfcbc-tc-hier-pd50-hm000-hb45-cl
job_spec.purpose: el1011-hbm-smh STRUCTURAL split of ot_hbm_accel_smh_tile_[ew]g (c7ac635fa CTS hold flood: one flat 129.6k-sink tree, 82.8k margin endpoints, 134k hold buffers): hardened per-leaf column tcc (16 BF16 lanes, 27.0k flops) with its own clock tree + reset relay, j-stage pin flops on every input, register-driven outputs; PD 0.5, route HM 0.0 ns. Benches: tile lockstep under OT_SMH_HIER (exact 8244) + late32/hold0 mutants. Parent: the tile with 4 column macros (round 2). | hb45: LOCAL ADDITION to the structurally sound column (not the structural fix): hm000 calibrate found 17,631 short flop-pair endpoints inside the margin (fp32-add/tree pipeline carries, real WNS -8.6 ps, TNS -1.5 ns) needing ~1-2 delay cells each; repair stopped at the 20 % instance buffer budget (25,044). Hold-delay stages on a hold-only near-miss, block at ~45 % util.

bench.name: lockstep_enreg_xlk
bench.cmd: W=$(mktemp -d /tmp/smtb.XXXXXX); python3 tools/dshbm_sm_pq_seq.py run --seq stress --nc 4 --smh --cg --define OT_SMH_CG_ENREG --define OT_SMH_XLK --define OT_FP_DATA_NORST --define OT_SMH_DRST0 --define OT_SMH_RSTRELAY --define OT_SMH_HIER  --cg-gap 300 --build-jobs 8 --workdir $W --out {RUN}/b_lockstep_enreg_xlk.json > {RUN}/b_lockstep_enreg_xlk.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {RUN}/b_lockstep_enreg_xlk.log | tail -5; grep -h CG_LOCKSTEP $W/*/runtime.log; test $rc -eq 0 && grep -q 'CG_LOCKSTEP mismatches 0 ' $W/*/runtime.log && grep -q '"total_cycles": 8244' {RUN}/b_lockstep_enreg_xlk.json && echo SMT_LOCKSTEP_PASS

bench.name: mut_late32
